items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I'd heard about them, but I hadn't heard them at all.

ctx.x: No. I'd heard about them, but I hadn't heard them at all.
That, of course, was a Jeanette, and it was the first of a series that they made.

I believe, as late as four or five years later, that even members of the Wolverines, if pressed, would have said that they were not influenced by New Orleans music particularly. I think they were wrong, and I think most of them would probably say so today, but their impression at that point was that they were not. All, I think, would say that the original Dixieland was an awful important move in music and that they'd certainly paid attention to it, but I don't think that they felt that they were playing it.
